reports.title: Vertex Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Vertex today raised its full year 2026 total revenue guidance to $13.15 billion to $13.25 billion from $13.1 billion to $13.2 billion previously. Embedded in this guidance are expectations for continued growth in CF, $500 million or more in revenue from CASGEVY and JOURNAVX combined, and $40 million to $50 million in revenue from PALSONIFY following the closing of the Crinetics Pharmaceuticals transaction on September 1. Total revenue guidance continues to reflect a year-over-year benefit of approximately 150 basis points from changes in foreign exchange rates, net of Vertex’s foreign exchange hedging program. Vertex is also increasing full year 2026 combined GAAP and non-GAAP R&D, AIPR&D, and SG&A expense guidance to reflect expenses primarily related to the operations and integration of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals for the remainder of 2026. Vertex GAAP guidance also includes approximately $500 million of compensation and transaction expenses noted above.
